independentVisualFindings: At source 106.3 and 106.8, the third-base-side left-handed-batter view shows the complete rounded barrel cap and loaded stance before forward motion. I find no frame-edge crop of the cap.

The side camera follows the same batter through the full attempt. Forward hand/barrel movement begins about 107.0; between roughly 107.4 and 107.9 the barrel moves toward the plate, then the hands and barrel arrest rather than continuing through a full wrapped finish. From about 108.2 to 108.9 the bat recoils toward the body and the batter settles. This reads as an attempted check, not an ordinary full swing.

The requested 106.25–108.95 MP4-clock bounds include the side-view loaded state, full attempted motion and initial recoil, then end before the top-of-second-inning graphic/next batter. The side replay contains no result, count graphic, appeal sequence or batter departure.

The earlier live segment at source 105.2–105.5 shows the home-plate umpire behind the catcher making the strike/punch signal after the same pitch; the scorebug identifies Gavin Sheets, the 3-2 bottom-first situation and the 86 mph slider. Fresh projected crew data lists Shane Livensparger as home-plate umpire. This links the visible gesture to the call without relying on crew assignment alone.
